name: Tile Installation Cost Per Square Foot: A Bellevue Price Breakdown
title-tag: Tile Installation Cost Per Square Foot | Bellevue, WA
meta-description: Tile runs $14-$26/sq ft installed near Bellevue. Why the range is so wide, where your project lands in it, and how to read a per-square-foot bid like a pro.
post-summary: September 8, 2026 · Tile installation runs $14-$26 per square foot installed — and the wide range exists because the square foot is the wrong unit. What the tile goes onto, what happens to that surface first, and how much cutting the layout demands decide your number. Here is how to place your project inside the range.
